title: Junior Python / ML Developer (Sample)
description: We are looking for a junior developer with strong Python fundamentals and exposure to machine learning. The candidate should be comfortable with pandas and numpy for data manipulation, have working knowledge of scikit-learn for building models, and understand SQL for querying relational databases. Familiarity with Git for version control and basic Linux command-line usage is expected. Experience with Streamlit or Flask for building demo applications is a plus.

title: Frontend React Developer (Sample)
description: Looking for a frontend developer skilled in React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. Must have solid HTML and CSS skills and understanding of REST APIs for backend integration. Git and basic CI/CD familiarity preferred.

title: Data Analyst (Sample)
description: Seeking a data analyst proficient in SQL and Excel, with strong data visualization skills using Tableau or Power BI. Python and pandas experience for scripting analyses is a strong plus. Statistics background required.
